core_statistics.post_max_hit_dice_rule: After 9d6 hit dice, gains +1 hit point per level at 10th-12th level. Hit point modifiers from Constitution are ignored.

permissions.shields: may use a weapon and shield

weapons.rule: May fight with swords, shortswords, daggers, composite bows, spears, and lances.

fighting_styles.rule: May wield a weapon and shield.
May wield a weapon in each hand.

restrictions.restriction: May not wield a weapon two-handed.

combat_rules.rule: Attack throw against AC 0 is 10+ at 1st level.
Attack throws and saving throws improve by 2 points every 4 class levels, as thieves.

access_rules.rule: Casts arcane spells as a mage of one-half class level.
Uses the same rules as mages for learning and casting spells.
May cast spells while wearing armor.
May use magic items usable by mages or thieves.

ability.name: classical_weapons_training
ability.summary: Receives a fixed attack bonus with either melee or missile attacks.

rules.rule: Gain +1 bonus to attack throws with either melee attacks or missile attacks.
The choice is made at 1st level and cannot be changed later.

ability.name: diplomacy_and_protocol
ability.summary: Improved parley with intelligent creatures.

rules.rule: Gain +2 bonus on all reaction rolls when attempting to parley with intelligent creatures.
This functions as the Diplomacy proficiency for reaction bonus purposes.

ability.name: inspire_courage
ability.summary: Can inspire nearby allies before battle.

procedure.step: Spend 1 round in oration before battle.
Allies within 50' who are not already engaged in combat are affected.

rules.rule: Affected allies gain +1 bonus to attack throws.
Affected allies gain +1 bonus to damage rolls.
Affected allies gain +1 bonus to morale rolls if monsters or NPCs are allied with the courtier.
Affected allies gain +1 bonus to saving throws against magical fear.

limits.limit: Cannot affect characters already engaged in combat.
A courtier can inspire courage in any given character once per day per class level.

ability.name: performance_training
ability.summary: Begins play trained in one performance mode.

rules.rule: Choose one type of performance known by the character: singing, recited poetry, or a group of instruments.
The Perform proficiency may be taken to learn other performance types.

ability.name: performance_magic
ability.summary: Can produce magical effects through performance.

rules.rule: May serenade creatures with a potential prurient interest, functioning as charm person.
May quiet savage beasts, functioning as sleep, but only against ordinary and giant animals of 4 HD or less.
This ability is usable at will.

limits.limit: May not be used if combat has already begun.

ability.name: elven_traits
ability.summary: Receives standard elven sensory, language, wilderness, and anti-paralysis benefits.

rules.rule: Gain +1 bonus to surprise rolls in the wilderness.
Detect hidden and secret doors with proficiency throw 8+ on 1d20 when actively searching.
Detect hidden and secret doors with proficiency throw 14+ on casual inspection.
Completely unaffected by ghoul paralysis.
Reduce target values for saving throws versus Petrification/Paralysis by 1.
Reduce target values for saving throws versus Spells by 1.
Speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

ability.name: establish_elven_fastness
ability.summary: May establish an elven fastness.

rules.rule: At 9th level, is expected to establish a fastness in a natural setting such as a forest or glen to further the family line.
The fastness follows all rules for elven fastnesses.

ability.name: spell_research_scrolls_and_potions
ability.summary: May create and research lesser magical works.

rules.rule: May research spells.
May scribe magical scrolls.
May brew potions.

acquisition_rules.rule: Fastness must be established in a natural setting such as a forest or glen.
Fastness follows the rules for elven fastnesses.

cost_rules.rule: Followers move in to help and defend the fastness at no cost to the character.

core_statistics.post_max_hit_dice_rule: After 9d4 hit dice, gains +1 hit point per level at 10th-12th level. Hit point modifiers from Constitution are ignored.

weapons.rule: May fight only with quarterstaffs, daggers, darts, or slings.

restrictions.restriction: May not fight with two weapons.

combat_rules.rule: Attack throw against AC 0 is 10+ at 1st level.
Attack throws and saving throws improve by 2 points every 6 class levels, as mages.

access_rules.rule: Learns and casts arcane spells as a mage.
May use magic items usable by mages.

repertoire_rules.rule: Spell selection is limited to the enchanter's repertoire.
Repertoire may include a number of spells up to the number and level of spells listed for the enchanter's class level, increased by Intelligence bonus.

ritual_access.rule: At 11th level, may learn and cast ritual arcane spells of 7th, 8th, and 9th level.

ability.name: mastery_of_charms_and_illusions
ability.summary: Charm and illusion magic is more potent.

rules.rule: When casting charm spells, spell effects are calculated as if the enchanter were 2 class levels higher.
When casting illusion spells, spell effects are calculated as if the enchanter were 2 class levels higher.
Targets of charm spells suffer a -2 penalty to saving throws.
Targets attempting to disbelieve the enchanter's illusions suffer a -2 penalty.

ability.name: prestidigitations
ability.summary: Can perform simple magical illusions and sleight-of-hand at will.

rules.rule: Can magically accomplish simple illusions and sleight-of-hand tricks suitable for impressing peasants.
To cast these prestidigitations, the enchanter must be able to perform the task physically and be free to speak and gesture.
May use magical sleight-of-hand to pick pockets as a thief of one-half class level.

ability.name: glamorous_aura
ability.summary: Presence can awe and charm observers.

rules.rule: Gain +2 bonus to reaction rolls to impress and intimidate people encountered.
If this bonus results in a reaction total of 12 or more, affected subjects act as if charmed while in the enchanter's presence.

ability.name: elven_traits
ability.summary: Receives standard elven sensory, language, wilderness, and anti-paralysis benefits.

rules.rule: Gain +1 bonus to surprise rolls in the wilderness.
Detect hidden and secret doors with proficiency throw 8+ on 1d20 when actively searching.
Detect hidden and secret doors with proficiency throw 14+ on casual inspection.
Completely unaffected by ghoul paralysis.
Reduce target values for saving throws versus Petrification/Paralysis by 1.
Reduce target values for saving throws versus Spells by 1.
Speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

ability.name: spell_research_scrolls_and_potions
ability.summary: May create and research lesser magical works.

rules.rule: May research spells.
May scribe magical scrolls.
May brew potions.

ability.name: greater_magic_item_creation
ability.summary: May create more powerful magic items.

rules.rule: May create magical weapons.
May create rings.
May create staffs.

ability.name: establish_sanctum
ability.summary: May build a sanctum and attract students.

rules.rule: May build a sanctum, often a great tower.

ability.name: ritual_arcana_and_magical_creation
ability.summary: Gains access to top-tier arcane rituals and advanced magical creation.

rules.rule: May learn and cast ritual arcane spells of 7th, 8th, and 9th level.
May craft magical constructs.
May create magical cross-breeds.
If chaotic, may create necromantic servants.
If chaotic, may become undead.

acquisition_rules.rule: May build a sanctum, often a great tower.
If the enchanter builds a dungeon beneath or near the tower, monsters begin arriving to dwell within, followed shortly by adventurers seeking to fight them.

cost_rules.rule: Apprentices and students must be provided food and lodging.
They need not be paid wages.

loyalty_or_morale_rules.rule: Many elven students become discouraged by rigorous mental training and quit after 1d6 months.
Elven students have above-average Intelligence scores.

core_statistics.post_max_hit_dice_rule: After 9d6 hit dice, gains +2 hit points per level at 10th-13th level. Hit point modifiers from Constitution are ignored.

weapons.rule: May fight with any missile weapons.
May fight with any one-handed melee weapons.

fighting_styles.rule: May wield a weapon in each hand.
May wield a weapon and shield.

combat_rules.rule: Attack throw against AC 0 is 10+ at 1st level.
Attack throws and saving throws improve by 2 points every 3 class levels, as fighters.
May use any magic item usable by fighters.

ability.name: archery_mastery
ability.summary: Elite missile combatant with scaling missile damage and accuracy.

rules.rule: Gain +1 bonus to attack throws with missile weapons.
Increase base damage roll from successful missile attacks by +1 at 1st level.
Increase missile damage bonus by an additional +1 at 3rd level.
Increase missile damage bonus by an additional +1 at 6th level.
Increase missile damage bonus by an additional +1 at 9th level.
Increase missile damage bonus by an additional +1 at 12th level.
May make missile attacks into melee at -4 penalty to attack throws.
Ranks in Precise Shooting may reduce this penalty to -2 or less.

ability.name: concealment
ability.summary: Can evade detection in wilderness and dungeon cover.

rules.rule: Can disappear into woods and underbrush in the wilderness with proficiency throw 3+ on 1d20.
In dungeons, if motionless and quiet in cover, can escape detection with proficiency throw 14+ on 1d20.

ability.name: tracking
ability.summary: Can follow tracks with improved skill.

rules.rule: Can follow tracks with proficiency throw 11+, applying modifiers from the Tracking proficiency.
If the ranger selects the Tracking proficiency, each rank reduces the required proficiency throw by 4.

ability.name: friends_of_birds_and_beasts
ability.summary: Understands and works well with normal animals.

rules.rule: Can understand the subtle body language and moods of normal animals, though the animals may not understand the ranger.
Gain +2 bonus to all reaction rolls when encountering normal animals.
May take animals as henchmen.
Can identify flora and fauna with proficiency throw 11+.

ability.name: animal_reflexes
ability.summary: Acts quickly and spots danger easily.

rules.rule: Gain +1 bonus to initiative.
Gain +1 bonus to surprise rolls.

ability.name: elven_traits
ability.summary: Receives standard elven sensory, language, wilderness, and anti-paralysis benefits, with ranger wilderness surprise stacking.

rules.rule: Gain an additional +1 bonus to surprise rolls in the wilderness from attunement to nature, for total +2 surprise in the wilderness.
Detect hidden and secret doors with proficiency throw 8+ on 1d20 when actively searching.
Detect hidden and secret doors with proficiency throw 14+ on casual inspection.
Completely unaffected by ghoul paralysis.
Reduce target values for saving throws versus Spells by 1.
Reduce target values for saving throws versus Paralysis by 1.
Reduce target values for saving throws versus Petrification by 1.
Speaks Common, Elven, Gnoll, Hobgoblin, and Orc.

ability.name: establish_elven_fastness
ability.summary: May establish an elven fastness.

rules.rule: At 9th level, may establish a fastness in a natural setting such as a forest or glen.
The fastness must blend seamlessly with nature.
The fastness follows the rules for elven fastnesses.

acquisition_rules.rule: Fastness must be established in a natural setting such as a forest or glen.
Fastness must blend seamlessly with nature.
Fastness follows the rules for elven fastnesses.

cost_rules.rule: Followers move in to help and defend the fastness at no cost to the character.
